source:
"Curiosity has killed many. Looking for that elusive border of reality, lurking in occult chats, investigating urban legends about the town of G... Is it really worth the price? Beware as you peer into the unknown, painstakingly extracting grains of truth from all those outlandish rumors and strange incidents — [i]they[/i] are bound to notice. As humans, we simply cannot withstand the magnetic temptation of forbidden knowledge. But are you willing to lose your mind over the answers to questions no one has ever asked?"
